caption: The drawing depicts a tall, wooden grandfather clock standing alone against a plain, beige background. The clock has a dark brown color with visible wood grain and is composed of three main sections: a lower rectangular base supported by four short legs, a middle section with a long paneled door, and an upper section housing the clock face. The clock face is circular and set within a slightly arched frame, featuring black Roman numerals, black clock hands, and a decorative pattern above the numbers in muted yellow and green hues. The top of the clock features a curved pediment with scrollwork and a central finial. The overall composition is centered, and the clock is rendered with detailed shading to indicate depth and texture. There are no other objects present in the drawing.
title: Grandfather Clock
